ideas.pitch: An autonomous AI agent that reads complex git diffs, traces dependency trees across multiple files, and generates complete, tested pull requests for large-scale codebase migrations.
ideas.problem_statement: AI CodeStorm 2026 challenge focusing on autonomous AI agents and AI-powered coding tools for software development, automation, and productivity.
ideas.title: AgentGit: Autonomous Multi-File Refactoring Agent
ideas.why_it_could_win: Directly tackles the agentic software development theme prioritized by judges, following the multi-file fix pattern from successful debugging agents like bobthebuilder.

ideas.pitch: A developer productivity tool that ingests legacy enterprise codebases, runs automated static profiling, and generates living architecture documentation and interactive sequence diagrams.
ideas.problem_statement: AI CodeStorm 2026 challenge focusing on software development automation and productivity using Large Language Models.
ideas.title: DocuMorph: Automated Legacy Code-to-Modern Specification Pipeline
ideas.why_it_could_win: Combines automated data profiling with LLMs to solve an immediate, painful bottleneck for engineering teams trying to onboard onto unmaintainable legacy repositories.

ideas.pitch: An AI-powered security agent that hooks into CI/CD pipelines, analyzes static analysis security testing (SAST) reports, verifies false positives via code execution sandbox, and auto-commits security patches.
ideas.problem_statement: AI CodeStorm 2026 challenge addressing cybersecurity, software automation, and productivity through AI agents.
ideas.title: SecuAgent: Automated Code Vulnerability Triage and Patching Agent
ideas.why_it_could_win: Targets the high-stakes domain of cybersecurity with an autonomous, end-to-end workflow rather than a simple wrapper chat interface.

ideas.pitch: A specialized IDE extension and web portal that observes student coding sessions, detects conceptual misconceptions in real-time, and scaffolds hints using Socratic questioning rather than just giving away answers.
ideas.problem_statement: AI CodeStorm 2026 challenge addressing education and AI-assisted coding tools for developers and learners.
ideas.title: EduCode: Real-Time AI Pair Programming Tutor for Students
ideas.why_it_could_win: Addresses the education domain explicitly called out in the prompt with a pedagogical approach that stands out from simple code-completion tools.

ideas.pitch: A secure, multi-agent platform designed to ingest unstructured clinical trial notes, normalize data formats, and cross-reference them against medical database standards using federated AI agents.
ideas.problem_statement: AI CodeStorm 2026 challenge focusing on healthcare, Large Language Models, and autonomous AI agents for real-world problem solving.
ideas.title: MedAgent Hub: Federated Clinical Data Verification Pipeline
ideas.why_it_could_win: Tackles a high-complexity industry (healthcare) with a sophisticated multi-agent system architecture reminiscent of winning enterprise-grade submissions.
